svg.title: Figure 4-1. Safety lifecycle per phase (WP-M-02 §4, §8, §11)
svg.desc: 7 phases P0 Governance, P1 Concept, P2 System design, P3 HW/SW development, P4 Integration and verification, P5 Validation and release, P6 Operation, each with its activities, responsible roles and key outputs, the confirmation measures and safety case content due at its gate, and the hold point at G1.
svg.text: Figure 4-1 · Safety lifecycle at a glance: phases, gates, confirmation and the safety case
One column per phase of §4. Each phase ends at its gate; the confirmation measures (§8) and the safety case content (§11) are those due at that gate
no public-road use before G1 and WP-V-07
